# clickup_audit_logs (Data Source)

Queries ClickUp audit logs via the V3 API. Returns the raw JSON response; use `jsondecode()` to parse.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workspace_id` (String) The ID of the Workspace to query audit logs for.

### Optional

- `applicability` (String) Type of logs to filter by. Options: `auth-and-security`, `custom-fields`, `hierarchy-activity`, `user-activity`.

### Read-Only

- `result` (String) The raw JSON response from the ClickUp V3 API. Use `jsondecode()` to parse it.
